# agentic-tables

Typed tables that agents read and write as rows.

Keywords: database,tables,airtable,rows,schema,agents,mcp,cli,structured-data.

- SDK: import { createTables, createMemoryStore } from "agentic-tables".
- CLI: agentic-tables new | list | schema | add-field | insert | update | query | required | delete-table | export-data | erase-data | export | import.
- MCP: run agentic-tables mcp, then call describe_table.
- HTTP: Worker from agentic-tables/worker, under /api/v1/tables. It answers 503 until AGENTIC_TABLES_UNSAFE_NO_AUTH=1 is set. Local use only.

## Docs

- README: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-tables
